parameters.query:
SET search_path TO hermes_outreach;
SELECT s.id AS state_id, s.lead_id, s.sequence_step, s.campaign,
       l.email, l.first_name, l.company, l.title, l.domain
FROM outreach_state s
JOIN leads l ON l.id = s.lead_id
WHERE s.status = 'in_sequence' AND s.next_send_at <= now()
  AND s.campaign = $1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach_sends
       WHERE campaign = $1 AND sent_at::date = now()::date) < $2
ORDER BY s.next_send_at ASC
LIMIT 1;

SET search_path TO hermes_outreach;
UPDATE outreach_state
SET sequence_step = CASE WHEN sequence_step < 2 THEN sequence_step + 1 ELSE sequence_step END,
    next_send_at = CASE
      WHEN sequence_step = 0 THEN now() + interval '7 days'
      WHEN sequence_step = 1 THEN now() + interval '7 days'
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    status = CASE WHEN sequence_step >= 2 THEN 'completed' ELSE 'in_sequence' END,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, sequence_step, status, next_send_at;
